name: verdict-stack
title: Verdict Stack
description: Interactive 100%-normalized outcome stacks with a grouped taxonomy legend that highlights one verdict across all subjects.

meta.question: What do each subject's outcomes consist of?
meta.whenToUse: Comparing the composition of outcomes or verdicts across subjects with a shared taxonomy (failure modes, ticket categories).
meta.antiUse: Reading exact segment values (no common baseline) — use a table; time series — use stacked-activity.
